name: Sirius
description: Brightest star in the night sky, located in the constellation Canis Major.

name: Betelgeuse
description: A red supergiant star in the constellation Orion, notable for its size and variability.

name: Polaris
description: Also known as the North Star, used for navigation because it sits nearly motionless in the sky.

name: Vega
description: A bright star in the constellation Lyra, often used as a photometric standard.

name: Rigel
description: A blue-white supergiant star in Orion, one of the brightest stars visible from Earth.

name: Antares
description: A red supergiant in the constellation Scorpius; often compared to Betelgeuse.
